about_desc: NexClaim is an AI-powered Insurance Claim Pre-Assessment Platform designed to simplify and accelerate healthcare insurance claim processing. The platform combines OCR, NLP, policy validation, confidence scoring, risk assessment, explainable AI, and human review workflows to help insurance providers process claims more efficiently while maintaining transparency and human oversight.
mission_desc: To reduce claim processing time, improve assessment accuracy, and provide explainable AI-assisted decision support for healthcare insurance claims.
vision_desc: To build a reliable and intelligent insurance ecosystem where policyholders receive faster claim assessments and reviewers are empowered with accurate, explainable insights.
founder1_desc: Passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Software Engineering. Contributed to the AI Decision Support Layer, Recommendation Engine, Risk Scoring, Confidence Scoring, Explainability, and overall system architecture of NexClaim.
founder2_desc: Focused on Policy Validation, Business Rule Engine Development, API Design, Data Validation, and backend architecture for reliable insurance claim assessment workflows.
founder3_desc: Specialized in OCR Pipeline Development, Document Processing, Information Extraction, NLP Integration, and structured insurance document analysis.
faq_a1: NexClaim is an AI-powered Insurance Claim Pre-Assessment Platform that helps process healthcare insurance claims using OCR, AI validation, risk assessment, and explainable recommendations.
faq_q2: Q2. How do I submit a claim?
faq_a2: Login to your Policyholder account, navigate to Submit Claim, upload the required documents, and click Process Claim.
faq_q4: Q4. How can I track my claim?
faq_a4: You can track claim status from your dashboard under My Claims.
faq_a5: Escalated means the claim requires additional review by an Admin due to risk factors, missing information, or validation concerns.
faq_q6: Q6. How secure is my information?
faq_a6: All documents and claim information are securely processed and access is restricted based on user roles.
faq_q7: Q7. Who makes the final decision?
faq_a7: AI provides recommendations, but final decisions are made by human reviewers and administrators.
faq_q8: Q8. What should I do if I forget my password?
faq_a8: Use the Forgot Password option on the login page to reset your password securely.
